Question ID: USH_U01_Pretest_Q01

MLA Standard: SS.912.A.1.1, SS.912.A.1.2, SS.912.A.1.5

Stimulus: source reliability checklist and corroboration table

Historical ContextEvidence DetailReasoning Task
Historians do not accept every source at face value. They ask who created it, when it was created, why it was created, what perspective it shows, what it leaves out, and whether other evidence confirms it.A political speech, newspaper article, photograph, law, court ruling, or personal account must be sourced by author, date, audience, and purpose.Explain context and evidence without drifting outside SS.912.A.1.1, SS.912.A.1.2, SS.912.A.1.5.
